title: Editor crashes after building C# project
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.7 and 4.8.dev1

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev1.mono - Ubuntu 26.04 LTS 26.04 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 (nvidia; 595.71.05) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 6-Core Processor (12 threads) - 15.05 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Godot editor closes by itself with no error messages when I build the C# project. I tried to build on a brand new project and the issue still happens.

The editor crashes even if the build is successful.

I tried deleting `/path/to/project/.godot` and `~/.local/share/godot` folders and it seems to temporarily solve the issue. However, after few builds, the issue returns, and all subsequent builds crash the editor again.

This is the log when running godot with `--verbose`:

### Steps to reproduce

- Create a new project
- Create the C# solution
- Add a script (can be empty)
- Build the project

or

- Open an existing project
- Make a change to a C# script
- Build the project

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A (issue happens on new projects)
